name: LemonSlice
long_description: LemonSlice is a frontier AI research and product lab building the future of interactive video. Our interactive avatar models allow you to turn a single photo into a real-time video call like FaceTime.
one_liner: Give your voice agents a face

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
I previously co-founded a profitable ML company that made $10 million. I received my PhD from MIT and Harvard. I am originally from Brazil and love dancing, playing music, and blogging/vlogging. I've always loved the intersection of tech and the arts. One of my first inventions was re-designing the traditional ballet point shoe for the 21st century. 
Follow along my YC vlog at: bit.ly/lina-youtube-channel

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: ML Engineering + Product. Prior to Infinity, I co-founded Edge Analytics, an ML consulting company that we grew to 12 mostly PhD-level engineers and $3M/year in revenue. Prior to that, went to MIT to get PhD in ML algorithms for medical imaging. Dropped out. Originally from Switzerland.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Over 10 years of experience working on AI/ML and synthetic media. Previously, I co-founded and led machine learning at Edge Analytics, a boutique consulting firm that developed algorithms and shipped products for startups and Fortune 500 tech companies, reaching $3M/year in revenue. I received my PhD in Bioengineering from Stanford University, where I performed research in medical imaging and computational neuroscience.
